title: Infisical, which helps companies use AI agents without handing over their private credentials, raised a $40M Series B led by Elad Gil at a $600M valuation (Rashi Shrivastava/Forbes)
summary: Rashi Shrivastava / Forbes: Infisical, which helps companies use AI agents without handing over their private credentials, raised a $40M Series B led by Elad Gil at a $600M valuation — Infisical is helping companies like Airbus and Volkswagen use agents without handing over their private credentials.
